title: Compatible Likelihoods for Flow Matching on Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2610.31981v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On the simplest non-Euclidean manifold, the 1D flat torus, we exhibit a distribution where a recently proposed extension of Riemannian flow matching is globally optimized by a velocity field that pushes samples away from the data distribution. We trace this failure mode to a property we call compatibility; a likelihood-based flow matching objective is compatible if its population minimizer recovers the marginal velocity field induced by the data and coupling. We give a general condition for compatibility, apply it to existing methods, and bound the worst-case error in terms of a residual component vanishing under compatibility. Next, we note that existing compatible objectives put density on velocities that are infeasible on compact manifolds. We propose an objective built from an exponential family over endpoints, with the conditional velocity as sufficient statistic, which is both compatible and supported only on feasible velocities.

translated_title: 流形上流匹配的相容似然
translated_abstract: 在最简单的非欧几里得流形——一维平坦环面上，我们展示了一个分布，其中最近提出的黎曼流匹配扩展方法被一个将样本推离数据分布的速度场全局优化。我们将这种失败模式追溯到一个我们称之为“相容性”的性质：如果一个基于似然的流匹配目标的总体最小化器能够恢复由数据和耦合所诱导的边际速度场，则称该目标是相容的。我们给出了相容性的一般条件，将其应用于现有方法，并通过在相容性条件下消失的残差分量来界定最坏情况误差。此外，我们注意到现有的相容目标将概率密度置于紧流形上不可行的速度上。为此，我们提出了一个基于端点上指数族构建的目标，以条件速度作为充分统计量，该目标既满足相容性，又仅支持可行的速度。
tldr: 该论文针对黎曼流匹配中基于似然的目标可能产生推离数据分布的速度场这一失败模式，提出“相容性”概念刻画似然目标的有效性，并进一步设计了一种基于指数族的新型目标，既满足相容性又仅支持紧流形上可行的速度。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies failure modes in likelihood-based Riemannian flow matching through the concept of "compatibility" and proposes a novel exponential-family objective that is both compatible and supported only on feasible velocities on compact manifolds.
